# NEXGEN CRETIONS

> Premium web design and development studio building modern, fast, responsive and SEO-friendly websites. We also share AI tools, internships, free certifications and tech content for students and professionals.

NEXGEN CRETIONS designs and develops custom business websites, portfolios, e-commerce stores, landing pages, dashboards and web applications. Alongside client work, we publish daily tech content across social media covering AI tools, career opportunities and programming resources.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, process, testimonials and social channels.
- [Services](/services): Full list of web design, development, SEO, AI integration and support services.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Selected projects across business, hospitality, education, industry and SaaS.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision and the topics we publish for students and professionals.
- [Tech Content](/tech-content): Categories we cover — AI, web dev, certifications, internships and career growth.
- [Contact](/contact): Project enquiry form, contact details and frequently asked questions.
